scenarios.description: Kept from full-rules: the landing page leads to the setup screen and a match starts against the bot.
Kept from full-rules: a legal deploy updates the constraint, the bot replies, and a non-matching cell shows its refusal reason.
Kept from full-rules: the player picks four distinct fighters, places the setup traps and starts.
Kept from full-rules: the log, status panel and rules panel follow a turn and the bot's reply.

At match start the player chooses the preset spec-v0.2-two-displacers, and picking a third displacer is refused with its reason; choosing the paper test 01 scenario shows the fixture board and A to move.
From a fixed seed under spec-v0.2, the test plays highlighted legal actions until the match ends, and the end screen shows the result, both objectives, both rosters and every trap with its fate.

On the player's turn the screen states whose turn it is, the constraint in words and what the player can do now; during the bot's turn the controls are disabled and the screen says the bot is thinking.
After the bot replies, the cells its action involved are highlighted and any trap trigger is called out on the board; the highlight clears after the player's next action.
On a first visit a short guide explains matching, the fighters and the Square objective; it can be dismissed, stays dismissed after a reload, and reopens from a help button.
With the dark colour scheme emulated, the board, terrain, symbols and fighter tokens stay distinguishable and all text meets a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background.
At a 390 px wide viewport the board, the constraint and the action controls fit without horizontal scrolling, and every cell and button is at least 44 px in both dimensions.
Using the keyboard only, the player moves focus across the board, selects a reserve fighter and deploys it on a highlighted cell.
